description: This PHP source file defines a custom class 'Table' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\\Installer\\Util\\V1\\Dto'. The class extends Doctrine's DBAL Schema Table class and adds methods for setting a schema manager, adding columns with specific options, and creating the table via the schema manager.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A subclass of Doctrine's Schema Table class, with added functionality to set a schema manager, add columns with options, and create the table.

methods.name: setSchemaManager
methods.description: Sets the schema manager to be used for table creation.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a column to the table with specified options and returns the table instance for chaining.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Uses the schema manager to create the table in the database.
